title: [29.x][ALL-E] Item Attributes (Decimal): Unable to Enter 0 After Clearing the Attribute Value to blank
summary: Decimal item attributes now correctly handle entering 0 after clearing a value to blank, by excluding blank records from numeric lookups.
key_points: Blank decimal attribute records were incorrectly matched when searching for value 0 due to default numeric values
Lookup logic now excludes blank attribute values when matching nonblank decimal values
Regression tests added to verify blank versus zero behavior and zero entry after clearing and reopening
Fixes inability to save decimal value 0 after clearing to blank on reopening the Item Attributes page
